category: Receipt scanning in a small-shop bookkeeping app
statement: For small shop owners who keep their own books and today type receipts into a spreadsheet at month end or pay a part-time bookkeeper. ShopTally Snap is receipt scanning inside the ShopTally bookkeeping app: snap a paper receipt and the amount, date and vendor are in the books. Unlike the spreadsheet or the bookkeeper, it books the receipt when the delivery comes, and the photo never leaves the phone.
headline: Snap a receipt and it's booked
subhead: ShopTally Snap is a new feature for small shop owners who keep their own books: receipts are read on the phone, and the photos are never uploaded.
